rows.text: The report's standfirst says Shri Nitin Nabin 'was elected unopposed as the new National President of Bharatiya Janata Party, making him the youngest to hold the party's top post on 19 January 2026'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The report says 'A formal announcement regarding Shri Nitin Nabin's election as the BJP National President was made on 20 January 2026' and that 'Dr. K Laxman, made the official declaration of the election'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The report opens: 'The Newly elected BJP National President Shri Nitin Nabin formally assumed charge at the party headquarters in New Delhi on 20 January 2026 in the gracious presence of the Hon'ble Prime Minister'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The report says 'Following the declaration of the result, outgoing party National President Shri JP Nadda handed over the charge to Shri Nitin Nabin at the party Headquarters in New Delhi'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The standfirst recalls that Shri Nabin 'was appointed as the Working President of the BJP on 14 December 2025'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: Among those who felicitated the newly elected President the report names 'former National President and Defence Minister Shri Rajnath Singh'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
